chunks: O ʿAlī, by Allah, if a lowly person were in the bottom of a well, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, would send to him a wind that would raise him above the righteous in the rule of the wicked.

O ʿAlī, whoever affiliates himself with other than his masters, upon him is the curse of Allah. Whoever withholds a hired worker’s wage, upon him is the curse of Allah. Whoever introduces an offense or gives shelter to an offender, upon him is the curse of Allah.

key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْأَشْرَارِ: the rule or ascendancy of the wicked
key_terms.غَيْرِ مَوَالِيهِ: other than his rightful masters or patrons
key_terms.لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ: the curse of Allah; divine rejection and condemnation
key_terms.مُحْدِثًا: one who commits or brings about a culpable offense

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about false allegiance, denying workers their wages, and protecting wrongdoers?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses Sayyidunā ʿAlī عليه السلام with a moral warning about how conditions of corrupt rule can invert appearances and elevate the lowly above the worthy. It then condemns three grave wrongs: false affiliation away from one’s rightful masters, withholding a laborer’s wage, and introducing or sheltering culpable wrongdoing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: (Prophet (sw) continued); O' Ali (as), by Allah (swt), if a lowly person were in the depths of a well, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Majestic, would send a wind to lift him above the righteous during the rule of the wicked.

O' Ali (as), whoever claims affiliation to other than his masters, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt). Whoever withholds the wages of a hired worker, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt). Whoever introduces an innovation or shelters an innovator, upon him is the curse of Allah (swt).
